args.title: Salt Marsh blog: Retail returns logistics — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns and its companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates reached 24%, underscoring the scale of the returns problem in retail logistics.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by about a fifth (20%), showing the efficiency gains from centralizing returns processing.
- Per the companion piece, reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin, highlighting speed-to-resale as the key value lever.
